program:
PARAMS = {
    "Is":    (60e-6, 20e-6, 200e-6),   # starving current per stage at mid vctrl (tt)
    "Ls":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),        # starving device L
    "Wn":    (0.84, 0.42, 3.0),        # ring inverter NMOS width
    "pn":    (2.5, 1.0, 4.0),          # ring inverter PMOS/NMOS width ratio
    "Rf":    (30e3, 5e3, 200e3),       # per-stage current floor resistor
    "Wb":    (2.0, 0.5, 8.0),          # output buffer NMOS width
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vlo, vhi = spec.get("vctrl_range", [0.7, 1.4])
    vmid = 0.5 * (vlo + vhi)
    VDD = 1.8
    N = 3
    CL = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    Linv = 0.15

    # starving NMOS width from forward model at mid vctrl (partly triode, vds~0.4)
    idu = lut.op("n", 1.0, p["Ls"], vmid, 0.4)["Id"]
    Ws = max(0.42, p["Is"] / max(idu, 1e-9))
    Ws = min(Ws, 200.0)

    Wn = p["Wn"]; Wp = p["Wn"] * p["pn"]
    Wb1n = max(0.42, p["Wb"] / 3); Wb1p = Wb1n * p["pn"]
    Wbn = p["Wb"]; Wbp = p["Wb"] * p["pn"]

    # capacitance per ring node: next-stage gate + own drains (~0.6x gate)
    cn = lut.op("n", Wn, Linv, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"]
    cp = lut.op("p", Wp, Linv, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"]
    cst = 1.6 * (cn + cp)
    cb1 = lut.op("n", Wb1n, Linv, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"] + lut.op("p", Wb1p, Linv, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"]

    def freq(l, vdd):
        isn = l.op("n", Ws, p["Ls"], vmid, 0.4)["Id"] + 0.45 * vdd / p["Rf"]
        ipp = l.op("p", Wp, Linv, vdd, vdd / 2)["Id"]
        tf = cst * vdd / 2 / max(isn, 1e-9)
        tr = cst * vdd / 2 / max(ipp, 1e-9)
        return 1.0 / (N * (tf + tr)), isn

    f_tt, _ = freq(lut, VDD)
    f_ss, _ = freq(lut.at("ss", 125), 1.62)
    f_ff, _ = freq(lut.at("ff", -40), 1.98)

    def power(f, vdd):
        cb2 = 1.6 * (lut.op("n", Wbn, Linv, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"] + lut.op("p", Wbp, Linv, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"])
        ctot = N * cst + cb1 + cb2 + CL
        return 1.3 * ctot * vdd * vdd * f   # 30% for crowbar/short-circuit

    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    for k in range(N):
        a_in = "a%d" % ((k - 1) % N)
        a_out = "a%d" % k
        x = "x%d" % k
        n.M("MP%d" % k, a_out, a_in, "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Linv)
        n.M("MN%d" % k, a_out, a_in, x, "vss", "nfet", Wn, Linv)
        n.M("MS%d" % k, x, "vctrl", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Ws, p["Ls"])
        n.R("RF%d" % k, x, "vss", p["Rf"])
    # output buffer
    n.M("MB1P", "b1", "a%d" % (N - 1), "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wb1p, Linv)
    n.M("MB1N", "b1", "a%d" % (N - 1), "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb1n, Linv)
    n.M("MB2P", "vout", "b1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wbp, Linv)
    n.M("MB2N", "vout", "b1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wbn, Linv)

    return n, {
        "f_mid": f_tt,
        "fmin": f_ss,
        "swing": 0.95 * VDD,
        "power": power(f_ff, 1.98),
    }
